objective_retained: Find three algorithm-level optimisation schemes for incrd-hg that actually pass the project's verification gate (7 splits, MiDrug up, LncDrug not down, with controls), and feed the schemes and correct results back.
input_bank: accepted context76 plus the provenance block established in the previous round (the schemes change the algorithm, not the input)

scheme_1_neural_member_model_class.recipe: pv_bce: 2-layer MLP member on [bank|prov], BCE, fused at w=0.1

scheme_2_cross_drug_pairwise_objective.recipe: pv_rank: same MLP, softplus(-(s_pos-s_neg)) over cross-drug pairs, fused at w=0.1

scheme_3_two_part_popularity_offset_stru.recipe: offset2: score = beta*(log1p deg_r + log1p deg_d) + MLP([bank|prov]), beta learned, fused at w=0.05

extra_pure_algorithm_no_new_columns.recipe: aggrank: Borda rank-average of the four accepted members on context76
extra_pure_algorithm_no_new_columns.gate: tolerance pass at every w; MiDrug inner +0.00003..+0.00010, LncDrug min -0.00027

conclusion: Three algorithm-level schemes (model class, objective, model structure) pass the strict 7-split gate with failing controls. All operate on the accepted bank augmented with the previously verified provenance block; pure algorithm changes on the original bank remain saturated.
